item.title: Shock for US figure skating, but big win for hockey in Friday Olympic competitions
item.description: Figure skater Ilia Malinin finished in eighth place in the men's figure skating final in Milan on Friday after falling twice during his routine. In hockey, the United States women's team defeated Italy 6-0 to maintain a perfect 4-0 record heading into the quarterfinals.

item.description: HUNTSVILLE, Ala. (WHNT) — Work will begin soon on a major infrastructure effort designed toimprove walkability, safety, and redevelopment opportunities in Huntsville. The city's pedestrian Access and Redevelopment Corridor (PARC) project will transform the Pinhook Creek area with new parks, greenways, and pedestrian connections linking neighborhoods, businesses, and downtown destinations.
